```{=html}
<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     DASHBOARD STYLES — inline so they always load
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<style>
/* ── Dashboard Layout ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.dashboard-page {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 60px);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%);
  padding: 2rem;
}
.dashboard-header {
  text-align: center;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
.dashboard-header h2 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}
.dashboard-header p {
  color: #F0EDE3;
  font-size: 1rem;
  margin: 0;
}
.dashboard-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.dashboard-card {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 2rem;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.dashboard-card h3 {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #006C93;
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}
.dashboard-card .card-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #A7A9AC;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
}
.dashboard-card hr {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  margin: 1.25rem 0;
}
.dashboard-card.danger {
  border: 2px solid #E05933;
}
.dashboard-card.danger h3 {
  color: #E05933;
}

/* ── Buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dash-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.dash-btn:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.dash-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}
.dash-btn.full {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
}
.dash-btn.small {
  padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.dash-btn.small.danger {
  background: #E05933;
}
.dash-btn.small.danger:hover {
  background: #c0392b;
}
.danger-btn {
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
  background: #E05933;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}
.danger-btn:hover {
  background: #c0392b;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ── Group Tabs ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.group-tab-wrapper {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0.25rem 0.5rem 0;
}
.group-tab {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #58595B;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.group-tab:hover {
  border-color: #006C93;
  color: #006C93;
}
.group-tab.active {
  background: #006C93;
  border-color: #006C93;
  color: #fff;
}
.group-delete-x {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  right: -6px;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #E05933;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.group-delete-x:hover {
  background: #c0392b;
}

/* ── Method Tabs ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.method-tab {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
  border: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #58595B;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  margin: 0 0.25rem 0.5rem 0;
}
.method-tab:hover {
  border-color: #006C93;
  color: #006C93;
}
.method-tab.active {
  background: #006C93;
  border-color: #006C93;
  color: #fff;
}
.method-panel {
  display: none;
}
.method-panel.active {
  display: block;
}

/* ── File Preview Table ───────────────────────────────────── */
#filePreview {
  max-height: 200px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
#filePreview table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
#filePreview th {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
  color: #006C93;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: #fff;
}
#filePreview td {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
}

/* ── Popup Overlay ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.auth-popup-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 1rem;
}
.auth-popup {
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
  max-width: 500px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
}
.auth-popup h3 {
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  color: #58595B;
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}
.auth-popup p {
  color: #58595B;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.credential-box {
  background: #f0fdf4;
  border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #58595B;
  word-break: break-word;
  max-height: 200px;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.auth-popup-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
  margin: 0.5rem 0.3rem 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00746F 0%, #006C93 100%);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}
.auth-popup-btn:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.auth-popup-btn.danger {
  background: #E05933;
}
.auth-popup-btn.danger:hover {
  background: #c0392b;
}
.auth-popup-btn.cancel {
  background: #e0e0e0;
  color: #58595B;
}
.auth-popup-btn.cancel:hover {
  background: #d0d0d0;
}

/* ── Auth Messages ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.auth-message {
  display: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  text-align: left;
}
.auth-message.error {
  display: block;
  background: #fef2f2;
  color: #dc2626;
  border: 1px solid #fecaca;
}
.auth-message.success {
  display: block;
  background: #f0fdf4;
  color: #16a34a;
  border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
}

/* ── Form Inputs (dashboard) ─────────────────────────────── */
.dashboard-card label {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #58595B;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.dashboard-card input[type="text"],
.dashboard-card input[type="number"],
.dashboard-card input[type="file"],
.dashboard-card select {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
  border: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
}
.dashboard-card input:focus,
.dashboard-card select:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #006C93;
}

/* ── Student Table ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dashboard-card table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
.dashboard-card thead th {
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem;
  color: #006C93;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
}
.dashboard-card tbody td {
  padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
  color: #58595B;
}
.dashboard-card tbody td:last-child {
  text-align: right;
}

/* ── Utility ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hidden { display: none !important; }
</style>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     LOADING / AUTH CHECK
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="authLoading" style="min-height:50vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00746F 0%,#006C93 100%);">
  <div style="background:#fff; border-radius:16px; padding:3rem; max-width:400px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
    <p style="color:#888;">Checking authentication...</p>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     DASHBOARD CONTENT (hidden until auth verified)
     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<div id="dashboardContent" style="display:none;">
  <div class="dashboard-page">
    <div class="dashboard-header">
      <h2 id="dashboardWelcome">Welcome</h2>
      <p id="studentCount"></p>
    </div>

    <div class="dashboard-grid">

      <!-- ── Groups / Classes ───────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card">
        <h3>Groups / Classes</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Organize your students into groups</p>
        <hr>
        <div id="groupTabs" style="margin-bottom:1rem;"></div>
        <form onsubmit="handleCreateGroup(event)" style="display:flex; gap:0.5rem; align-items:center;">
          <input type="text" id="newGroupName" placeholder="New group name"
                 style="flex:1; margin-bottom:0;">
          <button type="submit" class="dash-btn" style="margin-bottom:0;">Add</button>
        </form>
        <div id="groupMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Add Students ───────────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card">
        <h3>Add Students</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Create student accounts</p>
        <hr>

        <!-- Method tabs -->
        <div style="margin-bottom:1rem;">
          <button class="method-tab active" data-target="panelSingle">Single</button>
          <button class="method-tab" data-target="panelMultiple">Multiple</button>
          <button class="method-tab" data-target="panelImport">Import File</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Single Student -->
        <div id="panelSingle" class="method-panel active">
          <form onsubmit="handleAddSingle(event)">
            <label>Username</label>
            <input type="text" id="singleUsername" placeholder="e.g. john_doe" required>
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="singleGroup" class="group-select">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <button type="submit" class="dash-btn full">Create Student</button>
            <div id="addSingleMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Multiple Students -->
        <div id="panelMultiple" class="method-panel">
          <form onsubmit="handleAddMultiple(event)">
            <label>Username Prefix</label>
            <input type="text" id="multiPrefix" placeholder='e.g. "Student"' required>
            <label>Number of Accounts</label>
            <input type="number" id="multiCount" min="1" max="100" placeholder="e.g. 25" required>
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="multiGroup" class="group-select">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem; color:#888; margin:0.25rem 0 0.75rem;">Creates Student1, Student2, Student3, etc.</p>
            <button type="submit" class="dash-btn full">Create Students</button>
            <div id="addMultipleMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>

        <!-- Panel: Import from File -->
        <div id="panelImport" class="method-panel">
          <form onsubmit="handleImportSubmit(event)">
            <label>Upload .txt or .csv file</label>
            <input type="file" id="importFile" accept=".txt,.csv" onchange="handleFileSelect(this)">
            <label>Group</label>
            <select id="importGroup" class="group-select">
              <option value="Default">Default</option>
            </select>
            <div id="filePreview" class="hidden" style="margin:0.5rem 0;">
              <table>
                <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Username</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody id="filePreviewBody"></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="dash-btn full">Import Students</button>
            <div id="importMessage" class="auth-message" style="display:none; margin-top:0.5rem;"></div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Student List ───────────────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
        <h3>Your Students</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle" id="studentCount2"></p>
        <hr>
        <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Username</th>
                <th>Group</th>
                <th>Created</th>
                <th style="text-align:right;">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="studentTableBody">
              <tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align:center; color:#888; padding:2rem;">Loading...</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- ── Delete Class Account ───────────────────────── -->
      <div class="dashboard-card danger" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
        <h3>Delete Class Account</h3>
        <p class="card-subtitle">Permanently delete your account and all student data</p>
        <hr>
        <p style="margin-bottom:1rem;">This will delete your teacher account and all associated student accounts. This action cannot be undone.</p>
        <button class="danger-btn" onclick="handleDeleteTeacher()">Delete My Account and All Students</button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Scripts ────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<script src="js/admin.js"></script>

<script>
// ── Method tab switching ─────────────────────────────────
(function() {
  var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.method-tab');
  tabs.forEach(function(tab) {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
      // Deactivate all tabs and panels
      document.querySelectorAll('.method-tab').forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove('active'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.method-panel').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
      // Activate clicked tab and its panel
      tab.classList.add('active');
      var target = document.getElementById(tab.getAttribute('data-target'));
      if (target) target.classList.add('active');
    });
  });
})();

// ── Auth check — wait for _supabase ──────────────────────
(function() {
  function checkAuth() {
    if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
      setTimeout(checkAuth, 200);
      return;
    }

    _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
      var session = result.data.session;

      if (!session) {
        window.location.href = 'login-teacher.html';
        return;
      }

      _supabase.from('profiles')
        .select('username, role')
        .eq('id', session.user.id)
        .single()
        .then(function(profileResult) {
          if (!profileResult.data || profileResult.data.role !== 'teacher') {
            window.location.href = '/';
            return;
          }

          // Auth passed — show dashboard
          document.getElementById('authLoading').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('dashboardContent').style.display = 'block';

          // Initialize dashboard
          initDashboard(session, profileResult.data);
        });
    });
  }

  checkAuth();
})();
</script>
```
